opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation in a Bitcoin-mining pool, offering packages beginning at $500 and tying those purchases to equipment, daily Bitcoin production, and distribution among pool owners. Participation is described as lasting 1,000 days and includes mandatory reinvestment of 30% to 50%, while a historical example is presented as producing more than twice the investment. The arrangement also promotes commissions for bringing others into the opportunity, stating that viewers can make bitcoins “simply by sharing information.” It then directs viewers to copy a description link, register, fill out a form, and enter the associated office. These advertised returns, reinvestment requirements, bonuses or commissions, and registration instructions present a concrete earning opportunity, while assertions that it is legal and reliable do not substantiate the promised benefits.
